rules.title: [DRAFT] Strengthen AI and ML fundamentals
rules.body: [DRAFT] Review core concepts such as supervised learning, overfitting and probabilistic generation, then explain each in your own words with a testing example.

rules.title: [DRAFT] Practise techniques for testing AI systems
rules.body: [DRAFT] Apply metamorphic and property-based checks to a non-deterministic feature and document how you defined expected behaviour.

rules.title: [DRAFT] Build data-quality checks into your testing
rules.body: [DRAFT] Profile a dataset for representativeness, label consistency and drift, and add a validation test for one finding.

rules.title: [DRAFT] Review AI risk and governance practices
rules.body: [DRAFT] Map privacy, fairness and transparency risks for one AI feature and agree mitigations with stakeholders.

rules.title: [DRAFT] Use AI assistants with structured review
rules.body: [DRAFT] Pair AI-generated tests with a review checklist covering correctness, flakiness, security and maintainability.

rules.title: [DRAFT] Plan a measured AI adoption pilot
rules.body: [DRAFT] Define goals, success measures and safeguards for a small AI-in-testing pilot and share the results transparently.
